Over the course of the session, we became familiar with the previous faculty (Malay sir) teaching style, methods of note making, and approach to covering the syllabus. The sudden change of faculty in the middle of the academic session has created a sense of discontinuity in our preparation. With examinations approaching in approximately two months, maintaining consistency in teaching becomes especially crucial. Adjusting to a different teaching methodology at this stage may adversely affect our comprehension, revision strategy, and overall performance.
